request.context: SND-009 stage 1: three pilot-f voice candidates using approved Russian lines.
request.text: Я у штурвала. Слушаю вас. Маршрут передо мной. Можно сверить ориентиры. О повороте предупрежу заранее. Сонарщик, я на связи. Если понадобится остановиться, скажите.
request.voice_description: Adult female Russian speaker with native, accent-free Russian speech. A calm professional on a long expedition beneath the ice. Not an announcer or a film actor. Even, composed, mid-range timbre. Speaks briefly, used to giving commands. Clean dry voice, no radio effect, echo, static or music.
